title: Gnocchi Puttanesca
subtitle: with Olives, Capers and Cheese
description: One of the wonders of the culinary world, puttanesca is brimming with flavour and is a cinch to prepare! Simply simmer tomatoes, olives and capers to make the delicious sauce, then stir in soft pillows of gnocchi and sprinkle with cheese.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the gnocchi. Thinly slice the onion. Coarsely chop the olives. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Coarsely grate the cheese.
Soften onion: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic, season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring, for 4 mins or until softened.

Simmer puttanesca sauce: Add the tomatoes, olives, capers, 1 tsp sugar and 60ml (¼ cup) water to the onion mixture (see Make it spicy). Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 15 mins or until thickened. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat.
Cook gnocchi: Meanwhile, add the gnocchi to the pan of boiling water, stir to separate, then return to the boil and cook for 3 mins. Drain.

Serve up: Add the gnocchi to the puttanesca sauce and gently stir until evenly coated. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the gnocchi puttanesca among bowls and scatter over the cheese. Enjoy!
Make it spicy: If you like a kick of heat, add a pinch of chilli flakes to the puttanesca sauce in Step 3, or scatter over to serve if it's just for you.
